data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 长椅边的一枚秋叶
data.description: 秋日公园里，约尔穿系好腰带的米色风衣与及膝皮靴，侧坐在木长椅上，双膝自然并拢。一只手举着刚拾起的红枫叶，另一只手扶在长椅边，她把叶片转向阳光，红眸专注地看着透亮的叶脉，露出安静的笑。铺满落叶的小路从椅背后延伸。
data.promptProse: Beside a leaf-strewn path, a single red maple leaf catches the afternoon sun. Yor Forger from SPY x FAMILY sits sideways on a wooden bench, knees together beneath a belted beige trench coat and knee-high leather boots. She raises the leaf in one hand while her other palm rests on the seat. Ruby eyes study its translucent veins; black hair and gold earrings catch soft sidelight. Keep her seated silhouette large against the receding path, alone without lettering.
data.action: 侧坐长椅，一手将红枫叶举向阳光，另一手撑住椅沿。
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, seated environmental portrait
